description: Style of the game's cell-font text. colors: the colour table the strings and the map messages' ~C markup select by colour id, in the game's id order (gold 0 .. white 7); [r, g, b] in 0..255, where 128 is the texture's own brightness. message: a fresh map message's colour and line start x, the y of the first line at each box position of the ~J markup (bottom and lower rise by a line per extra line, grid sits on a half-line grid), and the glyph budget of a ~D (show the whole page) message. Coordinates are 320x240 screen pixels relative to the screen centre. Every key is checked: an unknown or missing key is an error.
